content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lawton

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific hour thresholds and degree pathways on PMI's official site, then contact Granite PM Academy to confirm your qualifications before enrolling in the Boot Camp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. This focused, interactive course delivers the formal education hours PMI requires, with expert instructors guiding you through the PMBOK® Guide framework and real-world project scenarios relevant to Lawton's defense and logistics sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once Boot Camp is complete, file your PMP application directly with PMI and remit the examination fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the submission process; PMI will review your credentials and issue authorization to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor office hours—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE and take the computer-based test at an authorized testing center, drawing on four hours of focused assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning and PDU-eligible courses to support your continuous growth as a certified project management professional.
